about: Reports how far a task has come. The track is the progress bar a screen reader reports, named by the label, and for a value the machine does not know a segment crosses the track.

animated.about: The stripes move at 40px a second while the work runs, so a value that updates slowly still reads as work in progress. They stop moving for a reader who asked for less motion.
animated.title: Moving stripes

bare.about: A bar without a label is named by `aria-label` on the track, as in a player's position under its controls. `aria-valuetext` states the position in minutes.
bare.title: Without words

effect.about: A halo around the range in the palette's solid. `pulse` animates it and stops for a reader who asked for less motion.
effect.title: Effects

layout.about: Stacked puts the label and the value above the track. Inline puts them on the track's row, the shape a bar takes in a table row or at the foot of a card, and the track takes the room the words leave.
layout.title: Layouts

outcomes.about: A test run split by outcome while it runs. `Progress.Segment` fills the track with the passed, failed and skipped tests, each in the palette its `color` states, and the rest of the track is the tests still to run. The value is the tests run so far, the segments' sum, and a key of the data package's `Status` names each palette with its count.
outcomes.label: Test run
outcomes.title: Outcomes while it runs

palette.about: Every palette in both looks. The outline look lays the range on a muted ground with an inset line, and the subtle look on the palette's muted role. A palette has no meaning of its own, so the label has to agree with it.
palette.title: Palettes and looks

plan.about: A migration against the share its plan expects by today. `Progress.Marker` crosses the track at the planned share, and the bar takes the warning palette while it is behind. The words and `aria-valuetext` state both shares, because the marker is hidden from a screen reader.
plan.label: Migrating customer records
plan.title: Against a plan

shape.about: The ends of the track, which the range takes too: square, rounded or full, on the thickest track.
shape.title: Shapes

size.about: The size is the thickness of the track: 4, 6, 8, 12 and 16px. The label and the value keep the label style at every size, so a thin bar under its words still reads as one thing.
size.title: Sizes

striped.about: Stripes over the range in the palette's contrast ink at a quarter strength.
striped.title: Stripes

title: Progress

unknown.about: A `null` value means the end is not known. A segment crosses the track once every 1.2 seconds and the value text is empty, so the bar never claims a share it does not know. For a reader who asked for less motion the segment spreads over the whole track and stops. The track reports no `aria-valuenow`.
unknown.title: Value unknown

units.about: `min` and `max` set the range in the units the work is measured in. The words over the bar and `aria-valuetext` on the track state the count, because the bar itself reports a share.
units.title: Counting in its own units
